name: SpiritVale Wiki Community Skills
notes: Secondary community Skill source. Individual detail pages provide stable locators, names, descriptions, class labels, max levels, cooldowns and costs. The site also publishes ranking/build material; those claims and damage-scaling fields are excluded from this registration.

name: SpiritVale DB Community Skills
notes: Community-maintained skill index. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the SpiritVale developer. Individual skill names, descriptions, class labels, effects, cooldowns, costs and max levels are accepted only when the exact listing and locator are retained; ranking, DPS, meta and best-build claims are never imported.

name: SpiritVale Official Steam Store
notes: Official product page used to verify the seven listed base-class names and system-level statements. Individual Card fields are allowed only when the page explicitly publishes them.

name: SpiritVale Official Press Kit
notes: Official Baikun Interactive Press Kit used for verified source assets; it does not authorize individual gameplay fields unless explicitly documented.

name: SpiritVale Info Community Cards
notes: Community-maintained Card index. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the SpiritVale developer. Individual fields require evidence and human review before publication.

name: SpiritVale Info Community Equipment
notes: Equipment source qualification pilot only. Community-maintained and not affiliated with or endorsed by the SpiritVale developer. Structured listings and detail pages expose selected equipment fields with page-level evidence; rarity is not consistently published and is intentionally excluded. No entity is approved by this registration alone.

name: SpiritVale Info Community Monsters
notes: Monster source qualification pilot only. Individual pages visibly publish names, levels, locations and drop listings. The source is community-maintained and not affiliated with or endorsed by the SpiritVale developer; unsupported stats, weaknesses, resistances, skills, spawn rates and drop rates must not be inferred.
